title: XML — Final Assessment Blueprint
attempts: Platform-controlled; do not infer or hardcode attempts in course content.
question_selection: Randomized selection from protected question pools after technical review; do not expose answer keys in public APIs.
outcomes: Create and inspect well-formed XML documents.
Model documents and use namespaces consistently.
Select XML data with XPath and transform it with supported XSLT/XQuery processors.
Choose DOM, SAX, StAX or streaming patterns based on access and memory needs.
Apply secure parsing, testing, performance and compatibility practices.
remediation: Review the relevant lesson and its knowledge check, then retry with a new equivalent question set. Exam scoring/certificate issuance must be enforced by the backend; passing this blueprint file alone does not issue a credential.
version_notes: Questions remain draft until reviewed against current standards and a named target processor. XSD 1.1, XPath 3.1, XQuery 3.1, and XSLT 2.0/3.0 support varies across processors.
